Container.Name: Collabora
Container.Overview:
Collabora Online - LibreOffice-based online office suite for OpenCloud 7.5+.
IMPORTANT (changed in OpenCloud 7.5): this container no longer overrides the entrypoint. The WOPI proof key is generated on the host by the OpenCloud pre-install script and mounted read-only at /etc/coolwsd/proof_key. The separate Collaboration/WOPI container is gone - WOPI now runs inside the OpenCloud container and is served on the main OpenCloud domain under /wopi.
aliasgroup1 must point at your MAIN OpenCloud domain, NOT a wopiserver domain.
Container.Requires: Run the OpenCloud pre-install script first to generate the WOPI proof key at /mnt/user/appdata/collabora/proof/proof_key

Config.Name: aliasgroup1
Config.Description: WOPI host allowlist. In 7.5+ WOPI is served by OpenCloud on the MAIN domain, so put your OpenCloud domain here (no wopi subdomain).

Config.Name: WOPI Proof Key
Config.Description: WOPI proof key generated by the pre-install script. Read-only.

Config.Name: DONT_GEN_SSL_CERT
Config.Description: Don't generate SSL certificates (TLS terminates at your reverse proxy)

Config.Name: extra_params
Config.Description: Extra Collabora parameters. frame_ancestors and lok_allow.host must be your OpenCloud domain. ssl.enable=false because SWAG/your proxy terminates TLS.
